title: Parse duration strings into seconds
request: Implement parseDuration(text) in src/duration.mjs. Accept one or more parts of the form <integer><unit>, where unit is d (days), h, m or s, for example "1h30m" or "10m5s". Return the total in seconds. Throw a RangeError for an empty string, for any other text, or for a unit that is not one of d, h, m, s.
